Right now, Deploy sends one line down that splits into three arrows going to Dev, Staging and Production at the same time.

Change it so Deploy points only to Dev, then Dev points down to Staging, then Staging points down to Production.

mwui0urfuksm7q.text:
Right now, the arrow from Branch goes through the lock and reaches main with an arrowhead.

Change it so the arrow stops at the lock. Remove the part of the line below the lock and its arrowhead, so nothing touches main.

chagne the intro line

Continuous delivery packages every tested change for release but keeps a human approval gate; continuous deployment removes that gate and releases automatically the moment tests pass

mwuiac1vyzkwq7.author: Pallavi
mwuiac1vyzkwq7.text:
for visual

Release and Deploy: Deploy → Dev → Staging → Production in sequence, not three parallel arrows.
Cost of Broken Main: stop the Branch arrow at the lock so it doesn't reach main.
Delivery vs Deployment: add "On demand" and "Several times a day" tags to the two rows.
Five Failure Points: add the 2 missing points or rename to "Three Failure Points."
Probes manifest: add a value to initialDelaySeconds: (for example, 5).
